cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r1 --slot 8 --why "Candidate 4 leads but candidate 1 still holds meaningful support, so this confirmation observation at the earliest slot maximally separating the 1-4 pair is needed before finalizing"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r1 --slot 19 --why "Candidate 4 support sits just under the resolution threshold with candidate 5 as the only remaining live rival, so this earliest maximal-separation slot for the 4-5 pair should confirm the resolution"

content.text:
Campaign complete for **case-30005** (run: `runs/final-case-30005-r1`):

- **Resolved: candidate 4** (period ≈ 15.65 d), final support **0.99995** ≥ θ=0.997
- Used **4 of 6** observations (slots 0, 4, 8, 19)
- Path: slot 0 eliminated candidates 0 and 2 outright and cut candidate 3 to near-zero; slot 4 collapsed the field to candidate 4 dominant (0.874) over 1 and 5; slot 8 pushed candidate 4 to 0.995 (just under threshold) with candidate 1 essentially dead; slot 19 delivered the confirming separation against the last live rival (candidate 5), crossing θ decisively.
- 2 observations left unused — no need to spend further budget once resolution was confirmed.
